notes: Placed from 3x to 8x crops of identity-run-0001.png (some contrast-stretched to separate overlapping legs and tails); ear-fan outer and top points are the mask extremes of each fan. Tails: the sheet shows exactly three tails in the left and back views (three plumes; the critic brief and R10 also count three), so tail_root_1 to tail_root_3 are marked top to bottom and tail_root_4 and tail_root_5 are null because those tails do not exist on the sheet, not because they are hidden. Hidden: front heel_l and heel_r (behind the toes, feet face the camera). Left view: the near (left) leg is the one whose foot is lower on the sheet and whose toes overlap the other foot (heel at x 892); hip, knee, ankle, heel and toe are on that leg. Above y 545 the near and far legs overlap without a visible boundary, so left.knee_l is the middle of the combined bend. Back view: hip_l is the centre of the left buttock where it is visible; its outer half is behind the tails. The three tail roots converge into one shadowed mass left of the buttock cleft, so each root is the point where that tail's fur becomes a separate mass (tail_root_3 least sure). Heels are the heel pad at the floor directly under each ankle, seen from behind. Front toe_tip_l and toe_tip_r: the toes face the camera and splay outward, so each is the middle of the toe row at the floor, claws excluded.
